# Terento

> Install free OpenTopoMap, Freizeitkarte and other OpenStreetMap maps on Garmin watches and Edge bike computers. Free Mac app or web installer.

Canonical website: https://terento.app/

This supplemental index does not replace the website, robots.txt, or sitemap.

## Key facts

- Terento is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later) project that installs and manages third-party maps on Garmin smartwatches and newer Garmin Edge bike computers (such as Edge 540, 840, 1040 and 1050) with map support. Handheld GPS and automotive devices are outside its scope.
- Two ways to use it: the Terento app for Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 13 or later, or the web installer at https://terento.app/install/ in desktop Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Opera or Brave, with no app to install.
- The maps are free community maps based on OpenStreetMap data: Freizeitkarte, OpenTopoMap, MapRando, BBBike and OSMapaPL. The Mac app downloads each map directly from its provider and can also install your own compatible .img map file.
- Terento does not update Garmin firmware or official Garmin maps and does not replace Garmin Express.
- The Compatibility page lists exact Garmin watch and Edge models and variants with at least one successful installation. A model missing from it is not necessarily unsupported.

## Public pages

- [Terento — Free Maps for Garmin Watches and Edge](https://terento.app/): Install free OpenTopoMap, Freizeitkarte and other OpenStreetMap maps on Garmin watches and Edge bike computers. Free Mac app or web installer.
- [About Terento: Free, Open-Source Garmin Maps](https://terento.app/about/): Why a Garmin hiker built Terento: a free, open-source way to get free maps onto Garmin watches and Edge bike computers. No account, no fees.
- [Download Terento for Mac: Free Maps for Garmin](https://terento.app/download/): Free, open-source Mac app for Apple Silicon (macOS 13+). Install, update and remove free maps on Garmin watches and Edge bike computers.
- [Garmin Watches & Edge: Successful Map Installs — Terento](https://terento.app/compatibility/): Terento is designed for Garmin smartwatches and newer Edge bike computers with map support. See exact models and variants with successful map installs.
- [Install Free Maps on a Garmin Watch from a Mac — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/install-garmin-maps-mac/): Put free OpenStreetMap maps or your own map file on a Garmin watch from an Apple Silicon Mac. No Garmin Express or BaseCamp needed.
- [Garmin Not Showing Up on Mac? Map Fixes — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/troubleshooting/): Garmin watch or Edge not showing up on your Mac, or the map is missing? Fixes for USB mode, Garmin Express, downloads and installs.
- [Install Garmin Watch Maps on Linux in Chrome — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/install-garmin-maps-linux/): Install free OpenStreetMap maps on a Garmin watch from Linux in Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Opera or Brave. One udev rule, no app.
- [Install Free Maps on Garmin Edge from a Mac — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/install-garmin-maps-edge-mac/): Put free OpenStreetMap maps on a Garmin Edge such as Edge 540, 840 or 1050 from an Apple Silicon Mac, then turn the map on.
- [Free Garmin Maps: OpenTopoMap, Freizeitkarte and more](https://terento.app/map-styles/): Compare free topo maps for Garmin watches and Edge bike computers: OpenTopoMap, Freizeitkarte, MapRando, BBBike and OSMapaPL, side by side in one place.

## Web installer

- [Install Garmin Watch & Edge Maps in Your Browser — Terento](https://terento.app/install/): Install free OpenStreetMap-based maps on your Garmin watch or Edge bike computer from Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Opera or Brave: connect by USB, choose, send.
